headline: Twamev Construction and Infrastructure Limited: General Updates
sum: General Updates - Twamev Construction and Infrastructure Limited has informed the Exchange about Intimation of sale of shares by Promoter and Promoter Group, Mr. Ravi Todi, M/s Ravi Todi HUF and M/s Nadia Security Printing and Stationery…
detail: General Updates - Twamev Construction and Infrastructure Limited has informed the Exchange about Intimation of sale of shares by Promoter and Promoter Group, Mr. Ravi Todi, M/s Ravi Todi HUF and M/s Nadia Security Printing and Stationery Co Pvt Ltd, respectively, to achieve the MPS of the Company.
